# Microsoft Agent Framework technology due diligence

The agent discovers recent warehouse-robotics developments, verifies material
company claims, labels uncertainty, and writes a decision-ready memo.

SerpApi enhancement: typed news and web tools replace the original local
demonstration function and turn tool use into a source-backed research loop.

```bash
uv run --with '.[microsoft-agent-framework]' \
  cookbook/microsoft-agent-framework/main.py
```

Read the
[complete cookbook entry](https://github.com/serpapi/serpapi-search-tools-python/tree/main/cookbook/microsoft-agent-framework)
or Microsoft Agent Framework's official Python
[tool-use example](https://github.com/microsoft/Agent-Framework-Samples/blob/main/00.ForBeginners/04-tool-use/code_samples/python-agent-framework-ghmodel-tools.ipynb).
